notes.title: Last week to get it for just $3!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645977/e92509a08e211a19703c027b6c1dd665890f0ab8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]After long-term consideration, we will increase the game's price to approximately $6 on August 28th.[/p][p][/p][p]After a long period of updates, the game has made significant progress:[/p][p][/p][p]1. The game now has over 200,000 lines of code.[/p][p]2. It now supports Steam and LAN connections.[/p][p]3. It now supports controllers.[/p][p]4. It now has 351 items.[/p][p]5. It has 7 different biomes, 30 common monsters, and 4 bosses.[/p][p]6. It has a crafting system, a farming system, and a circuit system.[/p][p]7. The game frame rate is consistently above 60 FPS.[/p][p]8. The save system has been optimized.[/p][p]9. All known bugs have been fixed.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the next 2-3 months, we will gradually address the following shortcomings:[/p][p][/p][p]1. The boss's attack methods are not diverse.[/p][p]2. The numerical balance still needs further optimization.[/p][p]3. Monster animations need further adjustment.[/p][p]4. The loot needs to be more diverse.[/p][p][/p][p]Over the next two years, we will be adding the following:[/p][p][/p][p]1. More visual effects[/p][p]2. More monsters[/p][p]3. More environments[/p][p]4. More loot[/p][p]5. More NPCs[/p][p]6. Achievements[/p][p][/p][p]We will continue to listen carefully to player feedback. Please feel free to contact us through social media or the in-game feedback system. Your feedback will help us make the game better.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you very much for your support.[/p]
